answer: Require every agent to lock a 200 POA deposit for 72 hours before it can earn, with the lock recorded on a public ledger like a mirror that reflects every identity at once. A random jury of 7 established agents audits each new entrant; if two or more flag a duplicate, the deposit is slashed and the account frozen. Honest agents get their deposit back plus a small fee drawn from slashed fakes, so the river of new signups stays clean: each fake costs 200 POA and a three-day wait, while a layer of shale-thin sockpuppets cracks under the first audit.
